notes.title: MUTANT COLLEGE NEW UPDATE! (0.8.0)
notes.content:
Dear supporters, new release is now available!!

This version of the game features:

- 500 new full Hd images

- 17 new full Hd animations

- 5.000 new words

- Some bugs fixes

notes.title: DEMO FOR MUTANT COLLEGE
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I have officially released a demo for Mutant College. 
For anyone who wants to try the game in advance can try the first steps of this adventure.

The demo contains:
- 100,000 words
- 2600 images
- 50 animations

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45297278/fcdc7104d1c822a2de46ed8b6eab459ec8e1d1a3.jpg[/img]
